nodes.label: Blue and white color palette
nodes.rationale: Deep navy conveys trust and compliance seriousness; lighter blues and white give contrast and a sense of clarity.

nodes.label: AML logo mark (36x36 SVG app icon)
nodes.norm_label: aml logo mark (36x36 svg app icon)
nodes.rationale: Compact square app-icon mark for the AML dashboard: a rounded blue tile carrying a rising transaction path that ends in a target ring, suggesting monitoring and detection of suspicious fund flows.

nodes.label: Three graduated blue nodes on the path (#8DB8EC, #A9C9F0, #C6DCF5)
nodes.norm_label: three graduated blue nodes on the path (#8db8ec, #a9c9f0, #c6dcf5)
nodes.rationale: Nodes represent accounts or transaction hops in a network, lightening along the path.

nodes.label: Zigzag signal path polyline (light blue to white gradient, round caps)
nodes.norm_label: zigzag signal path polyline (light blue to white gradient, round caps)
nodes.rationale: A line that dips and then climbs toward the upper right reads as a transaction trail or trend chart, fading from dim to bright to show escalation toward the flagged point.

nodes.label: Target ring with white center dot at upper right (r6 ring #5B9BE0, r3 white dot)
nodes.norm_label: target ring with white center dot at upper right (r6 ring #5b9be0, r3 white dot)
nodes.rationale: Bullseye or radar-lens motif marks the point of detection or alert where the trail ends.

nodes.label: Rounded tile background (navy gradient #003F88 to #00296B, rx 10, faint white border)
nodes.norm_label: rounded tile background (navy gradient #003f88 to #00296b, rx 10, faint white border)

nodes.label: Navy and light-blue palette
nodes.rationale: Colors: #003F88, #00296B, #8DB8EC, #A9C9F0, #C6DCF5, #5B9BE0, white; light tints are chosen for contrast on dark UI.

nodes.label: AML logo mark (dark variant)
nodes.rationale: Dark-theme variant of the AML dashboard brand mark: a 36x36 rounded navy tile with a light-blue transaction path and a target ring, using lighter tints so it reads on dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: Path node dots
nodes.rationale: Three small circles in progressively lighter blues at the path vertices, representing accounts or hops in a transaction network.

nodes.label: Zigzag transaction path
nodes.rationale: Polyline rising from lower left to upper right with a dip, stroked with a gradient fading from light blue to white; evokes money flow / transaction trail and rising signal.

nodes.label: Target ring with white core
nodes.rationale: Blue ring with a solid white center at the path end, like a magnifier or alert target; symbolizes detection or flagged entity in anti-money-laundering monitoring.

nodes.label: Rounded navy gradient tile
nodes.rationale: Rounded square (rx 10) with diagonal gradient from #003F88 to #00296B plus a faint #8DB8EC hairline border; gives the mark a solid trustworthy base.
